mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies today with a feel of 84 degrees out by Badger Ridge Middle School and a waning crescent moon in the sky.

In city news, the Plan Commission is meeting on September 8 to discuss development at 201 South Main Street, and our local students have finished submitting designs for the I Voted sticker contest for the upcoming election.
You can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness today, while tomorrow is packed with options like trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory, plus the Farmer's Market.
In our weekly report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for an O W I and cited for suspended registration.
Culver's of Verona is serving up Georgia Peach today and will be open until 10 PM. Also, you can grab a treat from the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4 PM.
